name: claude-code-setup
description: Holden's Claude Code setup: mods and plugins, installable from this marketplace.

plugins.name: k9s
plugins.description: A live, interactive k9s terminal in a Claude Code pane, two tools so the model can read and drive it, and a guard that routes the model to those tools instead of kubectl while the pane is open. Needs tmux and k9s on PATH.
